basics.name: Sharankumar Shastri
basics.label: Electric Machines & Electromechanical Engineer
basics.summary: Electric Machines/Electromechanical Engineer with 7+ years of academic and industrial experience in electric-machine design, motor-drive systems, electromagnetic modelling, controls, system validation, and engineering automation.

work.name: Jaguar Land Rover
work.summary: Leading cross-functional digital twin, rotor topology optimization, and physical/virtual validation activities for automotive e-Machines.
highlights: Leading cross-functional digital twin and test activities for electromagnetic product development, coordinating NVH assessment, magnetic/material evaluation, force measurement selection, test planning, supplier RFQ/RFI activities, risk assessment, and physical validation.
Developed a topology-optimization based motor design methodology to reduce rotor volume while maintaining torque and electromagnetic performance.
Defined component/system requirements and verification methods, created validation test cases with end-to-end traceability, and coordinated CAE-to-test correlation.
Used MATLAB/Simulink and dSPACE-based virtual validation environments for e-drive/controller testing, calibration, and verification activities.

work.name: Dyson
work.position: Motor Drives Engineer (Electromagnetic Design and Control), RDD
work.summary: Designed and optimized permanent-magnet systems for ultra-high-speed consumer-product motors (>150,000 RPM) and automated Python-ANSYS workflows.
highlights: Designed and optimized permanent-magnet systems for ultra-high-speed consumer-product motors (>150,000 RPM), considering magnetic performance, demagnetization margin, magnet retention, rotor structural limits, losses, and manufacturability.
Performed 2D/3D ANSYS electromagnetic FEA including nonlinear magnetic-material characteristics, magnet eddy-current losses, core losses, and high-frequency operating effects.
Automated Python–ANSYS electromagnetic analysis and flux-map generation, reducing manual simulation/post-processing effort for Simulink environments.
Evaluated magnetic materials and collaborated with suppliers on magnet specifications and manufacturing constraints.
